# RoomKhojo

> RoomKhojo is a room, PG, flat, and hostel discovery platform focused on Hanumangarh, Rajasthan. Browse verified listings with photos, rent, facilities, map location, and owner contact details.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://roomkhojoo.vercel.app/): Search rooms, PG, flats, and hostels in Hanumangarh.
- [About](https://roomkhojoo.vercel.app/about): What RoomKhojo offers and who it serves.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://roomkhojoo.vercel.app/terms): Platform usage terms.
- [Privacy Policy](https://roomkhojoo.vercel.app/privacy): How user and listing data is handled.
- [Refund Policy](https://roomkhojoo.vercel.app/refund): Paid listing and promotion refund rules.

## Listings

Each public listing has a canonical URL in the form `https://roomkhojoo.vercel.app/rooms/<listing-id>`. Listings include rent, category, room type, facilities, photos, map coordinates, and a contact action.

## Notes

- Listings are added by owners and are subject to approval before appearing publicly.
- RoomKhojo currently focuses on Hanumangarh, Rajasthan.
- Contact and listing details must be verified directly with the advertiser before payment or move-in.
